evals.prompt: Build an async TCP service `shout` using tokio. It listens on a configurable address, and for each connection reads newline-delimited UTF-8 lines and replies with each line uppercased. Requirements: at most N concurrent connections (configurable; extra connections wait for a slot), a per-connection idle timeout (configurable), lines longer than 8 KiB close that connection with an error line, and graceful shutdown on Ctrl-C that stops accepting, lets in-flight connections finish their current line, and exits within a bounded time. Include tests that exercise the protocol over a real loopback socket, the connection limit, the idle timeout, and the oversized-line case.
evals.expected_output: A tokio TCP service shout with configurable address, concurrency and idle timeout, bounded graceful shutdown, and real loopback behavior tests.

evals.prompt: Build a public library `slugkit` intended for publication on crates.io. API: a function that converts arbitrary UTF-8 text into a URL slug, plus a builder-style options type (separator character, maximum length, whether to transliterate common Latin accents to ASCII, a stop-word list). Invalid options (such as a separator that is alphanumeric, or a maximum length of zero) are typed errors. Provide complete public documentation with runnable examples, a property test showing slugs only contain allowed characters and never exceed the maximum length, and design the public API so future options can be added without a breaking change. Use license `MIT OR Apache-2.0`, repository `https://example.invalid/slugkit`, and a crate README.
evals.expected_output: A publishable, documented slugkit library with typed option errors, an extensible builder API, runnable examples, and property tests.
